739	  subroutine sumInvRClusterAsymm(env, nAtom0, nAtom1, coord0, coord1, charges1, invRVec,&
740	      & blurWidths1, epsSoften)
741	
742	    !> Computational environment settings
743	    type(TEnvironment), intent(in) :: env
744	
745	    !> Number of atoms in the first group
746	    integer, intent(in) :: nAtom0
747	
748	    !> Number of atoms in the second group
749	    integer, intent(in) :: nAtom1
750	
751	    !> Coordinates of the first group of objects (atoms)
752	    real(dp), intent(in) :: coord0(:,:)
753	
754	    !> Coordinates of the 2nd group of objects (point charges)
755	    real(dp), intent(in) :: coord1(:,:)
756	
757	    !> Charges of the 2nd group of objects
758	    real(dp), intent(in) :: charges1(:)
759	
760	    !> Vector of sum_i q_i/|R_atom - R_i] values for each atom
761	    real(dp), intent(out) :: invRVec(:)
762	
763	    !> Gaussian blur width of the charges in the 2nd group
764	    real(dp), intent(in), optional :: blurWidths1(:)
765	
766	    !> Short distance softening
767	    real(dp), intent(in), optional :: epsSoften
768	
769	    integer :: iAt0, iAt1
770	    real(dp) :: dist, vect(3), fTmp, epsSoften2
771	    integer :: iAtFirst0, iAtLast0, iAtFirst1, iAtLast1
772	
773	    if (present(epsSoften)) then
774	      epsSoften2 = epsSoften**2
775	    else
776	      epsSoften2 = 0.0_dp
777	    end if
778	
779	    call distributeRangeInChunks2(env, 1, nAtom0, 1, nAtom1, iAtFirst0, iAtLast0, iAtFirst1,&
780	        & iAtLast1)
781	
782	    invRVec(:) = 0.0_dp
783	
784	    ! Doing blurring and non blurring case separately in order to avoid the if branch in the loop
785	    if (present(blurWidths1)) then
786	      !$OMP PARALLEL DO&
787	      !$OMP& DEFAULT(SHARED) PRIVATE(iAt1, vect, dist, fTmp) SCHEDULE(RUNTIME)
788	      do iAt0 = iAtFirst0, iAtLast0
789	        do iAt1 = iAtFirst1, iAtLast1
790	          vect(:) = coord0(:,iAt0) - coord1(:,iAt1)
791	          dist = sum(vect**2)
792	          fTmp = charges1(iAt1) / sqrt(dist + epsSoften2)
793	          if (dist < (erfArgLimit_ * blurWidths1(iAt1))**2) then
794	            fTmp = fTmp * erfwrap(sqrt(dist) / blurWidths1(iAt1))
795	          end if
796	          invRVec(iAt0) = invRVec(iAt0) + fTmp
797	        end do
798	      end do
799	      !$OMP END PARALLEL DO
800	    else
801	      !$OMP PARALLEL DO&
802	      !$OMP& DEFAULT(SHARED) PRIVATE(iAt1, vect, dist) SCHEDULE(RUNTIME)
803	      do iAt0 = iAtFirst0, iAtLast0
804	        do iAt1 = iAtFirst1, iAtLast1
805	          vect(:) = coord0(:,iAt0) - coord1(:,iAt1)
806	          dist = sqrt(sum(vect**2) + epsSoften2)
807	          invRVec(iAt0) = invRVec(iAt0) + charges1(iAt1) / dist
808	        end do
809	      end do
810	      !$OMP END PARALLEL DO
811	    end if
812	
813	    call assembleChunks(env, invRVec)

  !> Expands a DFTB+ pair-wise neighbour list into complete per-atom neighbour lists.
  !>
  !> The regular neighbour list stores each atom pair only once (in the column of the
  !> atom with the lower index). The surface area integration of a given atom requires
  !> *all* of its neighbours, therefore the missing mirrored entries are added here.
  subroutine expandNeighbourList(nNeighbour, iNeighbour, img2CentCell, nAtom, &
      & nNeighbourFull, iNeighbourFull)

    !> Nr. of neighbours for each atom in the pair-wise list
    integer, intent(in) :: nNeighbour(:)

    !> Pair-wise neighbour indices
    integer, intent(in) :: iNeighbour(0:, :)

    !> Mapping of image atoms into the central cell
    integer, intent(in) :: img2CentCell(:)

    !> Nr. of atoms
    integer, intent(in) :: nAtom

    !> Nr. of neighbours for each atom in the complete list
    integer, allocatable, intent(out) :: nNeighbourFull(:)

    !> Complete neighbour indices
    integer, allocatable, intent(out) :: iNeighbourFull(:, :)

    integer, allocatable :: nFilled(:)
    integer :: mNeighbourFull, iAt1, iNeigh, iAt2, iAt2f

    allocate(nNeighbourFull(nAtom))
    nNeighbourFull(:) = 0
    do iAt1 = 1, nAtom
      do iNeigh = 1, nNeighbour(iAt1)
        iAt2f = img2CentCell(iNeighbour(iNeigh, iAt1))
        nNeighbourFull(iAt1) = nNeighbourFull(iAt1) + 1
        nNeighbourFull(iAt2f) = nNeighbourFull(iAt2f) + 1
      end do
    end do

    mNeighbourFull = maxval(nNeighbourFull)
    allocate(iNeighbourFull(0:mNeighbourFull, nAtom))
    iNeighbourFull(:, :) = 0
    allocate(nFilled(nAtom))

    nFilled(:) = 0
    do iAt1 = 1, nAtom
      do iNeigh = 1, nNeighbour(iAt1)
        iAt2 = iNeighbour(iNeigh, iAt1)
        iAt2f = img2CentCell(iAt2)
        nFilled(iAt1) = nFilled(iAt1) + 1
        iNeighbourFull(nFilled(iAt1), iAt1) = iAt2
        if (iAt2f == iAt1) cycle
        nFilled(iAt2f) = nFilled(iAt2f) + 1
        iNeighbourFull(nFilled(iAt2f), iAt2f) = iAt1
      end do
    end do

  end subroutine expandNeighbourList
